checks.name: Customer.email is present
checks.compiled_query:
CALL {
  CALL db.labels() YIELD label
  RETURN collect(label) AS _gc_labels
}
CALL {
  CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType
  RETURN collect(relationshipType) AS _gc_rel_types
}
WITH _gc_labels, _gc_rel_types

        CALL {
          MATCH (n:`Customer`)
          RETURN count(n) AS population,
                 sum(CASE WHEN n.`email` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                   AS conforming_count,
                 sum(CASE WHEN n.`email` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                   AS violation_count
        }
        RETURN 
all(name IN $required_labels WHERE name IN _gc_labels)

[name IN $required_labels WHERE NOT name IN _gc_labels] AS missing_labels,

,

               conforming_count,
               violation_count,
               CASE WHEN population = 0 THEN 1.0
                    ELSE toFloat(conforming_count) / population END AS coverage,

checks.name: Account.balance values have type integer
checks.compiled_query:
CALL {
  CALL db.labels() YIELD label
  RETURN collect(label) AS _gc_labels
}
CALL {
  CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType
  RETURN collect(relationshipType) AS _gc_rel_types
}

        CALL {
          MATCH (n:`Account`)
          WHERE n.`balance` IS NOT NULL
          RETURN count(n) AS population,
                 sum(CASE WHEN NOT (coalesce(
  CASE $expected_type
    WHEN 'string' THEN toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
    WHEN 'integer' THEN
      toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]+$'
    WHEN 'float' THEN
      toFloatOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
      AND NOT (
        toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
        AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =
          toStringOrNull(toIntegerOrNull(n.`balance`))
      )
    WHEN 'boolean' THEN toBooleanOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`
    WHEN 'date' THEN
      NOT (toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`)
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    WHEN 'datetime' THEN
      NOT (toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) = n.`balance`)
      AND toStringOrNull(n.`balance`) =~ '^-?[0-9]{4,}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T.*$'
    ELSE false
  END,
  false
)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count
        }
        RETURN

  AND all(name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE name IN _gc_rel_types) AS schema_ok,

checks.name: Customer relationship degree stays within 3 standard deviations
checks.compiled_query:
CYPHER 5
CALL {
  CALL db.labels() YIELD label
  RETURN collect(label) AS _gc_labels
}
CALL {
  CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType
  RETURN collect(relationshipType) AS _gc_rel_types
}

        CALL {
          MATCH (n:`Customer`)
          RETURN count(n) AS population
        }
        CALL {
          WITH population
          CALL {
            WITH population
            WITH population
            WHERE population <= $exhaustive_limit
            MATCH (n:`Customer`)
            RETURN n
            UNION
            WITH population
            WITH population
            WHERE population > $exhaustive_limit
            MATCH (n:`Customer`)
            WITH population, n, id(n) % 2147483647 AS _gc_sample_input
            WITH population, n, _gc_sample_input,
                 ((((($sample_gate_hash_a * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_gate_hash_b) % 2147483647) * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_gate_hash_c) % 2147483647) * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_gate_hash_d) % 2147483647 AS _gc_gate_key
            WHERE _gc_gate_key < toInteger(ceil(
                    toFloat(2147483647)
                    * toFloat($sample_size)
                    * toFloat($sample_gate_multiplier)
                    / toFloat(population)
                  ))
            WITH n, ((((($sample_hash_a * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_hash_b) % 2147483647) * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_hash_c) % 2147483647) * (_gc_sample_input) + $sample_hash_d) % 2147483647 AS _gc_sample_key
            ORDER BY _gc_sample_key, id(n)
            LIMIT $sample_size
            RETURN n
          }
          OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(other)
          WITH n, count(r) AS degree
          WITH collect({node: n, degree: degree}) AS sampled_nodes,
               coalesce(avg(toFloat(degree)), 0.0) AS mean_degree,
               coalesce(stDevP(toFloat(degree)), 0.0) AS degree_stddev
          WITH sampled_nodes, mean_degree, degree_stddev,
               [item IN sampled_nodes
                WHERE degree_stddev > 0.0
                  AND toFloat(item.degree) > mean_degree + $z_threshold * degree_stddev]
                 AS violations
          RETURN size(sampled_nodes) AS sample_size,
                 size(violations) AS violation_count,
                 mean_degree,
                 degree_stddev,
                 [item IN violations[0..$evidence_cap] |
                   {kind: 'node', id: elementId(item.node), labels: labels(item.node)}]
                   AS evidence
        }
        RETURN 
all(name IN $required_labels WHERE name IN _gc_labels)
  AND all(name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE name IN _gc_rel_types) AS schema_ok,
[name IN $required_labels WHERE NOT name IN _gc_labels] AS missing_labels,
[name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE NOT name IN _gc_rel_types]
  AS missing_relationship_types
,
               population, sample_size, violation_count,
               mean_degree, degree_stddev, evidence

checks.name: Property names do not expose likely personal data
checks.compiled_query:
CYPHER 5
CALL {
  CALL db.labels() YIELD label
  RETURN collect(label) AS _gc_labels
}
CALL {
  CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType
  RETURN collect(relationshipType) AS _gc_rel_types
}
CALL {
  CALL db.propertyKeys() YIELD propertyKey
  RETURN collect(propertyKey) AS _gc_properties
}

        CALL {
          MATCH (n)
RETURN coalesce(sum(size(keys(n))), 0) AS population
        }
        CALL {
          WITH population
          WITH population
          WHERE population > 0
          MATCH (n)
          CALL {
            WITH n
            UNWIND keys(n) AS property
          WITH property, n[property] AS raw
            WHERE raw IS NOT NULL

            WITH property, raw ORDER BY property
            WITH collect({property: property, raw: raw}) AS _gc_node_properties
            UNWIND range(0, size(_gc_node_properties) - 1) AS _gc_property_index
            WITH _gc_property_index, _gc_node_properties[_gc_property_index] AS occurrence
            RETURN occurrence.property AS property, occurrence.raw AS raw, _gc_property_index
          }
          WITH population, n, property, raw,
               (((id(n) % 2147483647) * 1103515245
                 + _gc_property_index) % 2147483647) AS _gc_occurrence_key
          WITH population, n, property, raw, _gc_occurrence_key,
               ((((($sample_gate_hash_a * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_gate_hash_b) % 2147483647) * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_gate_hash_c) % 2147483647) * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_gate_hash_d) % 2147483647 AS _gc_gate_key
          WHERE population <= $sample_size * $sample_gate_multiplier
             OR _gc_gate_key < toInteger(ceil(
                  toFloat(2147483647)
                  * toFloat($sample_size)
                  * toFloat($sample_gate_multiplier)
                  / toFloat(population)
                ))
          WITH n, property, raw, ((((($sample_hash_a * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_hash_b) % 2147483647) * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_hash_c) % 2147483647) * (_gc_occurrence_key) + $sample_hash_d) % 2147483647 AS _gc_sample_key
          ORDER BY _gc_sample_key, elementId(n), property
          LIMIT $sample_size
          RETURN collect({
            evidence: {kind: 'node', id: elementId(n), labels: labels(n)},
            property: property
          }) AS candidates
        }
        RETURN 
all(name IN $required_labels WHERE name IN _gc_labels)
  AND all(name IN $required_relationship_types WHERE name IN _gc_rel_types)
  AND all(name IN $required_properties WHERE name IN _gc_properties) AS schema_ok,
